caption: The drawing depicts a single metal object positioned at the center of a light beige or off-white background. The object appears to be made of dark gray or black metal and is composed of a horizontal bar extending to the left, which is connected to a vertical, square-shaped post rising upward on the right side. The vertical post is topped with a rectangular, decorated end featuring a slight scroll or curl. At the bottom, the post connects to two curved legs forming an arch that rest on the surface, creating a stable base. The right leg has a small upward turn at its end, while the left leg curves downward. The horizontal bar has a textured appearance and ends with a downward turn at the far left. The piece is solitary in the composition, with no additional elements or background details, and is drawn in a monochrome style that focuses on shading and outline to convey depth and form.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
